verdict.rationale: Svelte is a compiler-based UI framework used entirely through code, CLI and libraries [svelte-docs-1, svelte-gh-1]. It has no end-user product UI whose actions would need a matching API, so the question of API/UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. The 404 OpenAPI probe fits that picture: it reflects that Svelte is not a hosted service, not a failure to offer parity.
